design_detail: Ley Constitucional que crea el Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios: 0.25% to 1.5% of net wealth above 36 million tax units (individuals) or 100 million (companies)
quote_original: La Asamblea Nacional Constituyente (ANC), integrada por militantes del chavismo, aprobó este martes la creación de un impuesto a los grandes patrimonios
quote_en: The National Constituent Assembly (ANC), made up of Chavista militants, approved on Tuesday the creation of a tax on large fortunes
source_title: La Constituyente chavista aprueba un impuesto a los grandes patrimonios
grading_note: The assembly passed the law (en bloque); the thresholds were later raised to 150 million tax units in the reprint. The ANC is not recognised by much of the international community.

design_detail: Defence of the Ley Constitucional que crea el Impuesto a los Grandes Patrimonios (0.25% to 1.5% of total wealth)
quote_original: Esta ley a los grandes patrimonios es que el que más tiene más paga, y el que menos tiene no paga
quote_en: This law on large fortunes means that whoever has most pays more, and whoever has least pays nothing
source_title: La Constituyente chavista aprueba un impuesto a los grandes patrimonios
grading_note: His own words, quoted by EFE, presenting the named law to the assembly and giving its rates; a formal act as the member explaining the bill.

design_detail: Announced a Ley de Impuesto al Patrimonio for Venezuelans abroad
quote_original: Vamos a promover el que se considere una Ley de Impuesto al Patrimonio
quote_en: We are going to promote that a Wealth Tax Law be considered
source_title: Proponen impuesto para bienes de venezolanos en el exterior
grading_note: Names a wealth tax law (B); he says its main aim is to register the assets of Venezuelans worldwide more than to raise revenue, and gives no rate, threshold or bill text.
